Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 70

“As waters enter the ocean, which is filled yet remains unmoved, so the one whom all desires enter attains peace — not the one who longs after desires.”

The ocean does not refuse the rivers; it is simply too vast to be raised by them. Krishna's peace is capacious rather than defended — desires arrive and are absorbed without disturbance.
